messages:
anne_cs: Heads-up: GoldLeaf is going live with an APAC pilot next Tue. They asked for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist for peered egress. Can ops provision? Customer contact: meera@goldleaf.ai

sam_ops: Got it. What CIDR(s) do they need whitelisted? And how big of a bump? :thinking_face:

anne_cs: Meera sent two CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 2001:db8:85a3::/64. Looking for +3x qps (from 50->150) for the first 72h, then auto-revoke. Also wants region-specific routing to apac-edge.

michael_infra: We can do that but need an internal control-plane ticket + audit note. Also flag as 'renewal-momentum' — they're evaluating contract renewal mid-month. If we grant extra burst, capture usage spikes for billing/reg review.

paul_se: Config snippet we can apply (will run via infra playbook):
```yaml
customer: goldleaf
region: apac
allowlist:
  - 203.0.113.0/24
  - 2001:db8:85a3::/64
rate_override:
  qps: 150
  duration: 72h
  auto_revoke: true
tags: [apac-pilot, renewal-watch]
```

sam_ops: Need approval from security to accept IPv6 CIDR. @julia_re can you review?

julia_re: Quick check: both CIDRs look fine. Ensure IP ownership doc and customer signed addendum on network access. I uploaded the checklist to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: <https://app.redwood.ai/tickets/CS-8421|CS-8421> — infra will pick up. ETA 2 hours for staging change.

anne_cs: Thanks all — I'll loop Meera and get signed addendum. Please tag me when change goes live so I can confirm with the customer. :thumbsup:

michael_infra: Noted. We'll instrument metrics on per-tenant egress and set an alert if sustained >2x baseline for >4 hours. Also adding a temp billing flag.

paul_se: Change scheduled and will auto-revoke after 72h. Pushing to staging now.

deploy-bot: Change applied to staging at 2026-03-21T16:12:08Z. Prod rollout pending manual go from anne_cs.

anne_cs: On prod go — Meera just confirmed signed addendum. Please proceed.

deploy-bot: Prod change applied at 2026-03-21T17:03:21Z. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/changes/CS-8421

sam_ops: Verified burst routing to apac-edge, qps peaked at 158 for 5m then settled. FYI I'm leaving a note in renewal tracker.

julia_re: :white_check_mark: Sec sign-off recorded.

paul_se: Auto-revoke scheduled for 72h from prod apply. I'll monitor and post a confirmation after revoke.

anne_cs: Appreciate it — keep me posted. I'll add outcome to the renewal playbook.
